text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Following that historic victory.
We waited for Chrono Genesis to recover from her fatigue
and finally headed out to sightsee in the city, but—"

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"Magnifique course !
(I saw your race!)"

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Bravo!
(Congratulations!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
So many people are sending words of congratulations...
Before the race, this never happened, though.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Somehow... I feel like I've wandered into a completely different world.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The townscape... the flow of the river...
Even though the world before my eyes looks the same...
choice_data_list: It just means it was that big of a deal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A Japanese Umamusume winning the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
Even someone outside the racing world would understand what that means.
choice_data_list: A new history began with Chrono at its center.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes.
Though it doesn't feel like I'll get used to it anytime soon...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so.
I... I really made my dream come true, didn't I...?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
This race became an unforgettable, heated drama
in racing history, beyond anything else...
And I was able to etch it with my very own legs...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"If I've achieved such a huge dream...
maybe there's nothing left that could ever top it...?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"On the night of that victory, I even felt that way.
However—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...It's already inside of me.
A longing for a thrilling drama I haven't experienced yet."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I still can't see a clear shape.
However... I can feel a definite heat.
choice_data_list: Ah, your dream won't end after just one try
Yeah, your dream won't end after just one try.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Trainer... san...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like in my dream the other day, this is a miracle grasped among countless possibilities where I never made it here.
Giving up now would be far too wasteful.
choice_data_list: I want to see it again and again—the new history you'll create.
I want to see it again and again—the new history you will create.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Well then, um.
Will you search for it with me?
The next goal... the next dream... the next... drama.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
Thank you very much.
Well then... let us start anew from here.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah... but... you're right...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...I just now thought of what I want to do first.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Taking a trip to Maisons-Laffitte to visit the racing museum. If this dream is to continue, I need to learn about racing history across the globe... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the clear autumn sky.
Alongside the protagonist of a new history,
we took a step forward with smiles on our faces.
